An '''adamant mattock''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[mattock]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Hoe|diamond hoe]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It mines at speed 13 and has 5000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the adamant shovel or hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a [[Diamond Mattock|diamond mattock]] works as the base as well as a diamond hoe. Without the template, the same base and alloy make an [[Adamant Hoe|adamant hoe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 13.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 4.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Efficiency]] I
* {{G|Smelting}} Smelting: makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: ores drop ingots or [[Silver Bullion|silver bullion]], logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops stone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref>
* [[Unbreaking]] II

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_mattock.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|

{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Adamant tools now smelt the blocks they mine.}}
